inline_comments.comment: The bullet item is missing a merge request reference at the end. Project convention requires an `:mr:\`NNNN\`` cross-reference (see e.g. `20260321_005528_ppiaggi_plumed_stress.rst` which ends its bullet with `(:mr:\`4027\`)`). Please add `(:mr:\`<this MR number>\`)` before the trailing period.

There is a trailing blank line after the bullet item (between the bullet and the `.. Other changes` commented block). Project scriv conventions require no blank line after a bullet — the bullet text should flow directly into the next commented section.

The section heading is `Documentation`, but this change fixes a genuine rendering bug (an empty matplotlib figure/box was displayed due to `ax` being overwritten). The PR description itself describes it as a fix for leftover work from MR 4000 and references issue #1870. Consider using `Bugfixes` rather than `Documentation` to accurately reflect the nature of the change per project changelog conventions (functional fixes belong under `Bugfixes`, not `Other changes` or documentation sections).

`ax.set_axis_off()` is now redundant. The `plot_atoms` function already calls `ax.set_axis_off()` on the provided axes before returning (unconditionally), so this explicit call is a no-op. Since the surrounding code is being modified in this MR, this would be a good opportunity to remove the redundant line to avoid confusing future readers who may wonder whether `plot_atoms` handles axis visibility.

The added blank line between `fig, ax = plt.subplots()` and `plot_atoms(atoms, ax=ax)` is unnecessary. These two lines together form a single logical matplotlib setup step (create a figure+axes, then populate it), and separating them with a blank line reduces rather than improves readability.
